correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Johnson clique maximal facets: a star for fixed (k-1)-subset or a top for fixed (k+1)-subset, and each triangle belongs to only one. Descending elementary facet collapses give 2-skeleton; the hypersimplex cellular 2-skeleton is simply connected and uses all Johnson edges, yielding only H2. The equivariant signed Euler chain calculation yields the seven-term virtual expression, with oriented-edge sign module E counted twice in facet chains. The trivial component is 3+0-2-1=0; the full sign component vanishes by odd stabilizers, so both S_n and A_n rational orbit homology are reduced-acyclic. Independently checked (8,4) direct full-face signed Lefschetz traces = formula: 181 on identity, 1 on transposition and 3-cycle; not an extrapolation to all n,k.
residual_risks: Parameter range n>=6,3<=k<=n-3 excludes smaller line-graph cases; quotient claims only rational homology, not integral acyclicity or contractibility.
